37PjMTMt2iYfFuIFNvMc-w.zh: 法屬玻里西亞於今年第 17 週(4/20-26)報告 22 例病例,其中 15 例確診,多數病患因於某場所集體食用生食遭受感染。另該國去(2025) 年 11 月亦曾爆發沙門氏菌感染症群聚事件,影響超過 80 人,顯示食物製備人員衛生教育之重要性。
37PjMTMt2iYfFuIFNvMc-w.en: French Polynesia reported 22 cases in week 17 of this year (20–26 April), of which 15 were confirmed. Most patients were infected after eating raw food collectively at one venue. In November last year, the territory also experienced a Salmonella cluster affecting more than 80 people, which shows the importance of hygiene education for food handlers.

N2YNrkPXeiXozA-hwYc54Q.zh: 法屬玻里西亞今年疫情於2月底陡升,復於3月中旬趨緩後持續迄今,截至10/19累計報告153例病例,多數從事園藝/農業活動,其中逾8成病患之生活/工作環境存在老鼠。
N2YNrkPXeiXozA-hwYc54Q.en: In French Polynesia, cases this year rose sharply at the end of February, eased in mid-March and have continued since then. As of 19 October, 153 cases have been cumulatively reported. Most patients were engaged in gardening or agricultural activities, and in more than 80% of patients' living or working environments, rats were present.
